### [`samples/harbor-orders.history/reviews.json`](samples/harbor-orders.history/reviews.json)
14 PR review comments across PRs 12–27, April–August 2026. Themes covered:

| Theme | Comments | PRs |
|---|---|---|
| A — Shipped orders final / `AppError('ORDER_ALREADY_SHIPPED')` | 3 | #13, #19, #27 |
| B — `audit.record` not `audit.log`; event names `order.<verb>` + `{ orderId }` | 3 | #15, #20, #25 |
| C — Refunds via `payments.refund()`; never touch `total_cents` | 2 | #17, #23 |
| D — `clock.now()` not `Date.now()` | 2 | #14, #18 |
| E — Partial refund rounding (vague → precise `Math.floor`) | 2 | #15, #22 |
| Distractors (typo fix, variable rename) | 2 | #12, #21 |

### [`samples/harbor-orders.history/git-log.txt`](samples/harbor-orders.history/git-log.txt)
12 commits, newest-first. Includes the two required reverts:
- `Revert "Allow cancelling shipped orders" (#19)` — theme A
- `Revert "Refund by zeroing total_cents" - broke invoicing (#23)` — theme C

Remaining commits are ordinary feature/fix work (`markShipped`, `markPaid`, `applyDiscount`, `changeAddress`, etc.).
